description: Defines a Prop class within the OrangeHRM system for managing Vue.js component properties, including property names, types, and raw values.

classes.name: Prop
classes.description: Represents a Vue.js component property with name, type, and value, providing getter and setter methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new property with name, type, and optional raw value.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the property.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the property.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the property.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the property.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Returns the raw value of the property.

methods.name: setRawValue
methods.description: Sets the raw value of the property.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the JSON-encoded string of the raw value.
